_full_body: If you would like to respond to this notification, please place your response above the dotted line. A spigot in the north was broken by a homeowner and so the irrigation water in the north is off until the repair is made. A riser in the south was damaged last night and the irrigation water in the south is also turned off. As soon as the repairs can be made we will restore the irrigation water. We anticipate both will be completed by the end of the day. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
